args.query:
CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS
SELECT *
FROM measurements
WHERE reaction_ms NOT IN (
  SELECT reaction_ms FROM measurements
  WHERE reaction_ms < (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) - 2 * (MAX(reaction_ms) - MIN(reaction_ms)) / (COUNT(reaction_ms)-1) FROM measurements)
  OR reaction_ms > (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) + 2 * (MAX(reaction_ms) - MIN(reaction_ms)) / (COUNT(reaction_ms)-1) FROM measurements)
);
